question: Can replacing only the upright raise-body fold/replant sequence with the existing direct measured-pose rise reach standing and finite walking from the exposed upright entry?

controller_composition.phase_offset_semantics: The actual native initial-memory array order assigns offsets index * 90 within the 360-command gait cycle. This order differs from the compiled contact-site/display order; preserve it throughout the session.
controller_composition.stance_identity_correction: R10G composition.stance full ID named the different prone-to-standing V7. The actual V20 mapping in recovery_candidate_stance_profiles_v6.json selects stance_handoff_controller_v7. Preserve the old contract and correct the full name here; no executed controller change.
controller_composition.no_kick_hold_note: The hold is its own finalized V50 session because the anchored law height blend and the startup reference-velocity scale are keyed to memory creation time; a prelude inside the walking memory would silently remove V50 startup easing.
controller_composition.recovery_component_reuse: Original upright supervisor and Q passive entry are unchanged. Only upright raise-body composes existing V12 direct rise; V20 support and partial/prone recovery, V7 stance, V50 hold and V55 walking retain their laws.

matching.horizon: Each role uses its own prospectively bounded task completion, including exactly the same four planned foot cycles and stopping tail. Recovery time is part of the kicked task. Global elapsed horizons need not be equal; no equal-horizon causal effect, superiority or non-inferiority estimate is made.
matching.baseline_preparation_scope: Separate unchanged measured-joint ramp and zero-amplitude V50 hold, followed by fresh V55 walking. Preparation displacement and commands remain excluded from the finite walking task.

native_interaction.provenance: Unchanged R10F native interaction and source-measured first completed-step effect.

finite_walking_observable.cycle: A retained preparation release, actual native post-step absence during scheduled swing, then actual supported stance after the swing; use synchronized measured capsule endpoints. The independent reader must bind every request, response, clock, contact and memory transition.
finite_walking_observable.cutoff: First completion of all four measured planned cycles with all four feet in supported scheduled stance, then exactly 120 zero-amplitude and zero-speed commands. Failure to finish within 1600 walking commands is a bounded negative.
finite_walking_observable.threshold_provenance: The 3-sample airborne dwell, 12 mm foot advance and 20 mm body advance are unchanged magnitudes from the original development walking evaluator. The new observable identifies planned gait cycles rather than treating every stance contact loss as an intended step. No old campaign is regraded.
finite_walking_observable.body_advance_measurement: Measured torso position immediately before the first walking command to the final post-stop native torso position, projected onto the initial anatomical horizontal forward axis. The neutral-entry segment is excluded.

settled_tail.provenance: Unchanged V49/V50 prospective cycle-stop conditions; require every final 30 observation, not an average.

whole_walking_envelope.provenance: Unchanged original finite development walking limits. Native engine health, bounded joint-only actuation, identity, contact truth and the complete recovery energy invariants also remain mandatory.

unintended_support_loss_contract.scope: This prospective task tests bounded kick-triggered recovery, four measured intended foot relocations and settled stopping. It does not establish uninterrupted stance contact, arbitrary duration walking or contact robustness. Every existing negative remains accessible.

first_diagnostic.question: Exercise source-verified upright direct rise, V7 standing, fresh V55 walking and the complete stop through the real launcher and reader.
first_diagnostic.coverage_adequacy: Only upright actuation changes. One fresh kicked child covers the changed branch; unchanged no-kick and partial/prone compatibility are first checked at the native/adapter interfaces. This diagnostic makes no paired-effect claim.

development.if_first_diagnostic_negative: Retain and close R10R development negative; no later declared R10R cells may launch.

if_first_diagnostic_positive.additional_cells_require: Fresh phase-246 pair is valid and positive; each later diagnostic is individually declared and gated.

implementation_contract: All producers, worker branches, session and source identities, launch ownership, bounded stepping, complete capture, finalization, independent replay and finite evaluation must pass the full applicable safety gate before development physics.

stance_entry.initial_memory: Fresh native joint-pose-entry memory, independent of prefix, hold and subsequent V55.
stance_entry.measured_support_source: original native completed-step presence AND bears_support for each of four feet
stance_entry.geometry: From synchronized measured distal body poses and compiled capsule centers, calculate each endpoint independently. For each of the 73 upright zero-bias reference heights at smoothstep(n/72), n=0..72, from measured torso height to floor+radius+0.33, require the positive-knee sagittal IK solution to exist within all compiled hip and knee position limits. No cosine or angle clamping. The selected recovery morphology has hip anchor parent y=0; the standard quadruped descriptor hip y=-0.05 is not this native recovery body.
stance_entry.geometry_claim_limit: Readiness tests the stationary-anchor, zero-bias startup reference path. It does not guarantee later contact or feasibility under measured support correction or native motion. Native refusal remains authoritative.
stance_entry.kicked_entry: After actual separately typed prone, partial or upright completion, require all current native support/motion and geometric readiness once before creating the fresh V55 walking session. A failed check is a bounded negative; no hidden actuation or rewritten recovery history.
stance_entry.timeout: At command 240, missing readiness terminates as a bounded negative with the complete native record. No fallback controller, reset, extended horizon or new attempt under the same identity.
stance_entry.parameter_basis: Reuse the existing 240-step stance timeout and existing 30-sample/.03m/s/.15rad/s/.05rad settled criteria. The 73 reference heights are the exact endpoints and 72 command intervals of unchanged V50 startup. No acceptance threshold is loosened.
stance_entry.ramp_ready_rule: Native reference_ramp_complete AND measured upright AND zero_bias_reference_path_feasible on the same completed step. This transfers into V50 support acquisition; four measured supports and all five readiness checks remain required for 30 consecutive hold samples before walking.

hold.initial_memory: fresh canonical V50 memory, independent of the ramp session and of the later walking session
hold.task_frame: legacy adapter frame with the same exact perpendicular-axis rule as the neutral start; no anatomical frame profile
hold.declared_startup_transient: V50 canonical initial support memory targets neutral joints; the first commands slew from straight-leg targets back to the measured flexed goals at up to the controller cap. Measured in the pair, not hidden.
hold.timeout: At hold command 240, missing readiness terminates as v50_hold_entry_timeout with the complete native record. No fallback, reset, extended horizon or new attempt under the same identity.
hold.settled_criteria_provenance: Unchanged 30-sample/.03 m/s/.15 rad/s/.05 rad criteria and the unchanged 73 zero-bias reference heights.

entry.motor_impulses: Every measured motor impulse is zero, as required by the original passive collector.
entry.not_an_acceptance_pose: Entry does not assert that joints already lie within their final acceptance limits or that all four feet bear. Those remain measured recovery completion requirements, as in the prone route.

raise_and_completion.gain_reference: The last original passive sample that initialized this new partial task; the kick energy epoch and original source observations are unchanged.
raise_and_completion.joint_limits_actuator_caps_and_no_cheat: Unchanged exact native morphology/cap contracts, complete energy partition, and no intervention or state rewrite.
raise_and_completion.gain_rationale: The original 0.22 m criterion belongs to a task starting in ventral prone. This distinct task starts above the prone ceiling but at no more than half the reference torso height. It requires at least 0.10 m of measured COM rise as well as the same absolute standing geometry and stability. The changed entry and gain define a new task; they cannot regrade R10J or establish canonical prone recovery.

partial_recovery.measurement_identity: Post-handoff observations carry the new task and semantics identifiers at their original producer before source hashing. Shared native validation kernels may be reused under an explicit task scope. Never rewrite an already observed canonical task identifier or source-binding digest.

prone_recovery.parent_profile: The existing exact-S169 physical development threshold profile.
prone_recovery.unchanged: 60 consecutive standing samples, all original entry, rise, contact, geometry, speed, cap and energy requirements, all other phase timeouts, and the 1200-command total bound.
prone_recovery.rationale: The observed prone child ended in measured stable stance with 47 consecutive samples. The distinct budget permits more settling time; it does not predict that another 13 samples would have succeeded or permit continuation of the old child.

zero_amplitude_command_scope.initializing_memory: Preserve bounded V53 feedback during initialization, with absolute motor target speed at most 0.25 rad/s.
zero_amplitude_command_scope.later_zero_amplitude_commands: Request zero motor velocity with motors enabled and unchanged impulse caps.
